cards.text: Friend, John, a servant of Jesus, is writing to seven churches about a vision he was shown on the island of Patmos (Revelation 1:1, 4, 9). Six angels have sounded their trumpets so far, and heavy things have followed (Revelation 8:6-9:21). Then John sees another mighty angel coming down from heaven.

cards.question: The mighty angel comes down from heaven wrapped in a ___.

cards.text: There's a rainbow above his head, his face is like the sun, and his legs are like pillars of fire. Me? I've got a gold base and a mustache, and I thought THAT was making an entrance.

cards.question: The mighty angel holds a small scroll lying open in his hand. Then he plants his feet. Where do they go?

answers.text: One on the sea and one on the land
One on the mountain and one in the valley
One on the river and one on the shore

cards.text: Then the angel cries out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cries out, other voices sound.

cards.question: When the mighty angel cries out like a roaring lion, the seven ___ sound their voices.

cards.text: When the seven thunders have spoken, John is about to put it all in writing. Pen up, ready to go, like me the second I hear a new cookie recipe.

cards.question: John writes down what the seven thunders said.

cards.text: A voice from heaven tells John, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.” Then the angel standing on the sea and on the land lifts his right hand to heaven.

cards.question: With his right hand raised to heaven, the mighty angel swears by the seven thunders.

cards.text: He swears by Him who lives forever and ever, the One who created heaven, the earth and the sea, and everything in them.

cards.question: The mighty angel swears by the One who created everything. What does he announce?

answers.text: There will be no more delay

cards.text: Then the angel points ahead to the seventh angel, whose trumpet hasn't sounded yet. In those days, he says, something of God's will be fulfilled.

cards.question: The angel says something will be fulfilled when the seventh angel begins to sound his trumpet. What is it?
The angel says the mystery of God will be fulfilled just as God proclaimed it to His servants the prophets.

cards.text: Then the voice John heard from heaven speaks to him again. And this time, it gives him a job.

cards.question: The voice from heaven speaks to John again and gives him a job. What is it?

answers.text: Take the small scroll from the angel
Write a letter to the seven churches
Count the servants who were sealed

cards.text: So John walks up to the mighty angel standing on the sea and on the land and says, “Give me the small scroll.” Friend, I'd need three tries just to get out "excuse me."

cards.question: John asks for the small scroll. The mighty angel tells him to take it and ___ it.

cards.text: Then the angel adds, “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.” So John eats a whole SCROLL, friend, and here I feel guilty licking a little dough off my mustache!

cards.question: When John eats the small scroll, it turns out exactly the way the angel said it would.
After eating the small scroll, John is told what he must do next. What is it?

answers.text: Prophesy again about many peoples and kings
Wait in silence for the last trumpet
Keep the vision sealed for a while

cards.text: So John's got more prophesying ahead of him. Friend, this story isn't done yet, so stick around.
